title: Program Manager, Data Center
description:
**Company Overview**

United Electric Company is an established union electrical contractor serving commercial and industrial customers across multiple markets. Since 1957, we've built our reputation on quality workmanship, safety, reliability, and strong customer relationships. Our success is driven by skilled professionals, experienced field leadership, and a commitment to delivering exceptional service and results for our customers.

**Our Core Values**

At United Electric Company, we are **Committed** to our team, clients, and community through unwavering honesty, reliability, and loyalty. We are **Relentless** in our pursuit of innovative solutions, field excellence, and continuous growth. Above all, we remain **Humble**—always putting others, from our team to our clients and vendors, before ourselves.

**Position Summary – Connecting Our Values through your work**

The Electrical Program Manager oversees groups of related projects for our larger customers, including multi-site rollouts, repeat work, and long-term accounts. This role is the single point of accountability for the customer across all of it. The Program Manager works with our project managers, field leadership, and estimating to keep every job safe, on schedule, and profitable, and to make sure the customer sees the same level of quality and communication from the first site to the last.

**Role Specifics: Data Center Operations**

Specifically within data center operations, the Program Manager will oversee high-density mission-critical infrastructure, ensuring 100% uptime, robust redundancy, strict compliance with critical power and cooling facilities requirements. This includes managing complex electrical equipment deployments, uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, generator backups, and specialized infrastructure management programs across all active site builds.

title: Director, AI Engineering and Delivery
description:
The Director, AI Engineering & Delivery leads a multidisciplinary team of machine learning engineers, data scientists, software engineers, and MLOps/DevOps specialists to design, build, deploy, and maintain AI/ML systems. This role bridges technical leadership, people management, and execution readiness, ensuring AI products are innovative, reliable, scalable, maintainable and integrated seamlessly int our global AI product portfolio.

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Team leadership & management
  + Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI/ML engineers, software developers, and MLOps engineers.
  + Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide coaching, and oversee career development.
  + Foster a culture of fast paced innovation, technical excellence, collaboration and continuous learning
* Technical architecture and design
  + Oversee the design and architecture of AI/ML systems, AI pipelines, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment Enterprise AI and broader software ecosystems.
  + Collaborate with data engineering to ensure the data infrastructure supports AI/ML applications.
  + Partner with AI Product Owners and Solution Managers to translate business requirements into technical roadmaps.
* AI/ML development & delivery
  + Manage project timelines, scope, risks, and dependencies across AI engineering initiatives.
  + Oversee and ensure the team follows best practices for model development, versioning, testing, validation, and deployment.
  + Define and enforce engineering standards for code quality, documentation, development tools
  + Communicate progress, challenges, and technical decisions to leadership and stakeholders.
* MLOps & deployment
  + Ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable infrastructure for AI applications.
  + Establish and champion MLOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines for ML, automated testing, model registry and monitoring, and versioning.
